## PLUGIN CONFIG SCHEMA (authoritative — read validators carefully)
The planner prompt's JSON schema below cannot represent `@model_validator(mode='after')` or cross-field `@field_validator` bodies. Treat the source below as the single source of truth for any cross-field invariants; a proposed config that violates one will be rejected by the resource-eval skill and burn a retry attempt.

```python
class DualDomainChirpFuserConfig(BaseModel):
    model_type: str = Field(default="dual_domain_chirp_fuser", description="Plugin model type key.")
    segmentation_size: int = Field(ge=1)
    batch_size: int = Field(default=256, ge=1)
    stem_channels: int = Field(default=64, ge=16, le=128, multiple_of=2)
    residual_channels: int = Field(default=64, ge=16, le=128, multiple_of=2)
    skip_channels: int = Field(default=64, ge=16, le=128, multiple_of=2)
    temporal_blocks: int = Field(default=9, ge=5, le=9)
    spectral_width: int = Field(default=32, ge=8, le=64)
    spectral_blocks: int = Field(default=2, ge=1, le=4)
    fusion_hidden: int = Field(default=64, ge=16, le=256)
    temporal_dropout: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=0.3)
    spectral_dropout: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=0.3)
    fusion_dropout: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=0.3)

```

task_description:
Estimate binary-neutron-star chirp mass from H1/L1 whitened detector observations containing injected signals. Each prepared sample is whitened_injected[:, 15104:16128], the fixed [59, 63) second window at 256 Hz. Inputs are float32, two channels of 1024 samples. No per-example amplitude normalization is applied. The target is stored chirp_mass in solar masses. Source masses, SNR, clean signals, backgrounds, and other simulation parameters are excluded from model inputs.
Preprocessing follows the owner-supplied PhyTS paper and is already materialized. The released training and validation splits are preserved. The full training split is the available pool; select training fractions within the experiment budget. Predict one scalar in physical units for each example. Any target standardization must use training statistics only and be inverted inside the exported model. The primary selection metric is global validation R2 (higher is better); global RMSE is also reported. Formal scoring uses all validation examples; per-epoch validation loss uses the fixed 10% subset. Test data are absent. Paper test scores and campaign validation scores describe different populations.
validation_disclosure: TRAINING VALIDATION OVERRIDE: Per-epoch validation loss uses an operator-fixed snapshot fraction 0.1 of the task's eligible validation population within the declared data scope. The recorded evaluation seed selects it once per attempt; all epochs reuse it. This overrides any description of epoch loss sharing the score scope. Your eval_portion changes Trial final inference/scoring only, not this epoch-loss snapshot. Formal final inference/scoring retains the operator's formal_eval_portion. Budget validation cost using the snapshot row count and completed epochs, separately from final inference.
historical_formal_appendix: RUN-SPECIFIC DATA/SCORE CONTRACT: Trial training strategy and fractions (`trial_portion`, `train_portion`) and Trial validation fraction (`eval_portion`) are your choices. Formal training strategy and fractions also come from your validated plan's `trial_strategy`, `trial_portion` and `train_portion`; choose them for the Formal round. Formal validation does not use your `eval_portion`: it is operator-fixed at 1 of the declared validation scope. A valid full-scope Formal score is the official comparable result; Trial scores are development feedback, not the official result.
